campos.descripcion: The SparkFun RTK Facet is an easy-to-use, all-in-one surveying solution that delivers NGS-calibrated, centimeter-grade accuracy to your phone or GIS device over Bluetooth, complete with a built-in L1/L2 antenna and ZED-F9P module.
